_note: DEFAULT is the public OpenPeppol/Helger service. Copy this file to config.json (same folder) ONLY if you want to change that. To use a self-hosted validator, RENAME '_endpoint' to 'endpoint' and set your URL (keys starting with '_' are ignored, so as long as it stays '_endpoint' the public Helger service keeps being used). config.json is gitignored and preserved across skill updates. All keys optional; an explicit -Endpoint / -VesId on the command line still wins.
